headline: The wanted sheet prints five
lede: Papers, Please-Min's bulletin now carries the arcade original's five wanted portraits — a third decoy name goes on the wall every day, and the twin-trap days hide their planted criminal in a fuller line-up. No font shrink was needed: the fifth row clears the scale box with room to spare, and paperscheck's new witness makes sure the fifth slot can never quietly die.

notes.text: Fifth wanted portrait: sheets print 3-5 entries (was 2-4); grading unchanged — the rule stays NAME *AND* NUMBER, so the extra decoys raise the near-miss surface without touching fairness.
paperscheck 6553/6553 with a slot-used witness (deepest==5, one five-entry day per seed-week) and a five-portrait synthetic worst day; mutant m11 (decoys back to two) dies; papersplay 19/19 clean.

A claim win can still be a collision: slot b won #1637 on the checkpoint namespace while slot a's session was still alive editing the same files. Handoff instead of race — rebase, commit the rival's in-flight fixes, post the state, yield, then run the never-dry ladder to a shipped game in the same shift.

Prod verification by content, not hash: Vercel's build hashes differ from local dist, so the live PapersPleaseMin chunk was found by grepping its strings and the decoy loop checked in minified form (w<3).
